items.topic: Identify report as a systematic review
See PRISMA 2020 for Abstracts checklist
Rationale for review in context of existing knowledge
Explicit statement of objective(s) or question(s)
Inclusion/exclusion criteria and how studies were grouped for syntheses
All databases, registers, websites, organizations, reference lists and dates last searched
Full search strategies for all databases, registers and websites including filters/limits
Selection process: how many reviewers, independence, automation tools
Data collection process: reviewers, independence, obtaining/confirming data
List and define all outcomes for which data were sought
List and define all other variables sought and assumptions for missing/unclear data
Study risk of bias assessment tool, reviewers, independence
Effect measures specified for each outcome
Processes used to decide which studies were eligible for each synthesis
Methods required to prepare data for synthesis (handling missing summary stats, conversions)
Methods used to tabulate or visually display results of individual studies and syntheses
Methods used to synthesize results and rationale (meta-analysis model, heterogeneity estimator, software)
Methods used to explore possible causes of heterogeneity (subgroup analysis, meta-regression)
Sensitivity analyses conducted to assess robustness of synthesized results
Methods used to assess risk of bias due to missing results (reporting biases)
Methods used to assess certainty/confidence in body of evidence (e.g., GRADE)
Results of search and selection process from identification to inclusion (with PRISMA flow diagram)
Cite studies that might appear to meet inclusion criteria but were excluded and explain why
Cite each included study and present its characteristics
Present assessments of risk of bias for each included study
items.comment: D1 allocation risk plotted for all 13 trials from published `alloc`; D2–D5 require full-text dual-reviewer RoB 2 adjudication.

items.topic: For all outcomes, present summary statistics per group and effect estimate with precision for each study
items.evidence: results/study-results-table.md & manuscript/results.md (all 13 studies n/N and RR with 95% CI)

items.topic: For each synthesis, summarize characteristics and risk of bias among contributing studies
Present results of all statistical syntheses (summary estimate, precision, heterogeneity measures)
items.evidence: manuscript/results.md para 1 & figures/figure1-bcg-forest.svg (pooled RR, 95% CI, 95% PI, Q, tau2, I2)

items.topic: Present results of all investigations of possible causes of heterogeneity
items.evidence: manuscript/results.md para 2 (latitude subgroup analysis >=35 deg vs <35 deg)

items.topic: Present results of all sensitivity analyses conducted
Present assessments of risk of bias due to missing results for each synthesis
Present assessments of certainty/confidence in body of evidence for each outcome
General interpretation of results in context of other evidence
Discuss limitations of evidence included in review
Discuss limitations of review processes used
Discuss implications of results for practice, policy, and future research
Registration information (register name, number) or state not registered
Indicate where review protocol can be accessed or state not prepared
Describe and explain any amendments to registration or protocol
Sources of financial/non-financial support and role of funders/sponsors
Declare competing interests of review authors
Report availability of data, analytic code, templates, and other materials
